topic: Data migration and analytics review for new facilities
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on migrating data and applying historical models across multiple facilities. Initial issues included needing to apply a model retroactively and transferring data from old locations to new ones.

Later, the conversation addressed technical display issues, specifically why two newly added facilities were not appearing correctly on the Live map despite having coordinates and traffic data. It was determined that the issue might be related to caching or timing delays in the system's updates.

Multiple links and dashboard views (STAGE vs. PROD) were reviewed to compare historical performance metrics, particularly focusing on sessions and traffic for specific facilities. The team agreed on a plan to stabilize the data display before running final calculations.
decisions: The model application and data transfer process was prioritized due to urgency.
A review of dashboard links (STAGE vs. PROD) confirmed discrepancies in displayed metrics.
It was decided to postpone the full recalculation until the next day's morning check.
action_items: Ensure data is correctly transferred and model applied for all facilities, including historical dates.
Investigate and resolve the display issue preventing two new facilities from appearing on the Live map.
Monitor dashboard performance in the morning before running final calculations.
